profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
I seek to expand my existing knowledge, skills, and experience while pursuing innovation, creativity, and graceful architecture.

Specialties: Objective-C, C, C++, JavaScript, Go, CSS, XHTML

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with a small team to ship TuneIn Radio and TuneIn Radio Pro from versions 2.3-3.0.
Built a threadsafe data vending scheme, enabling consistent user interface display and behavior across the application.
Implemented and released Car Mode, a simple and nondistracting interface for automotive users.
Built an MFi accessory manager, allowing general support for customized experiences on connected devices.
Created an interface for supported MFi JVC head units which was demoed at CES 2012 and released in February 2012.
Helped create a customized interface for MFi Clarion head units.
Created programming interfaces for and worked with contractors on supporting various MFi products.
Introduced application/system version reporting to TuneIn API calls, allowing marketshare to guide company decisions.
Created a new abstraction around TuneIn OPML requests with improved extensibility, configuration, and performance.
Developed a new architecture for browsing the TuneIn content directory and presenting table views.
Worked with server team to migrate to a new device identification scheme.
Simplified and streamlined beta distribution and App Store submission processes.
Performed periodic audits of the iOS codebase to identify ways to improve code quality and architecture.
Helped transition the engineering team to using git for version control, including a two-part introductory presentation.

positions.title: iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated to ship the Maps application and MapKit framework in iOS 4-5.
Shipped the Compass application in iOS 4-5.
Helped maintain and enhance an internal framework supporting an Objective C Protocol Buffers runtime.
Created a new internal framework for location based services in iOS 4.
Fixed location/heading tracking issues in the MapKit framework and Maps application in iOS 4.
Completed Apple Security Lead training and delivered a presentation on Information Security to the Maps Team.
Helped review security and privacy measures in location-related iOS features.
Collaborated to design the CLGeocoder API launched in iOS 5.
Helped design new geocoding protocols and implemented the client-side geocoding infrastructure in iOS 5.
Made numerous important fixes to StreetView in Maps, reducing related network traffic significantly, in iOS 5.
Implemented generic and configurable throttling system to prevent excessive or abusive network usage in iOS 5.
Presented Visualizing Information Geographically with MapKit at WWDC 2011.
Worked on components of prototype software demoed to upper management.

positions.title: Server Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, refactored and maintained server side functionality for a social mapping service.
Made significant performance improvements to Loopt's Facebook application.
Helped launch landing pages to offer experiences to a broader range of platforms.
Implemented third party email synchronization in C# to allow marketing campaigns for increasing service awareness.
Designed and implemented a fault tolerant service link in C# using the Facebook Connect API, resulting in increased service virality.
Helped implement an application server interface to Apple Push Notification service, facilitating a more engaging user experience.

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
Designed, implemented, and maintained client and server side functionality for the company website.
Took initiative to develop a C# framework for simple XML transformations, custom ASP .NET control in C# for selective content rendering, and a cross-browser compatible JavaScript debugging tool.

positions.title: Database Consultant
positions.description: MySQL database replication and PHP integration for the Stanford Psychology Department.

positions.title: Programming Contractor
positions.description: Developed Java Swing application to parse and compare student records with a partial matching algorithm.

positions.title: Web Consultant
positions.description: Implemented a specified cognitive reaction time measure in JavaScript for experiments performed by the Stanford Psychology Department.

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description: Developed Java Swing application for probabilistic analysis and visualization for Phoenix Mathematics, Inc.

positions.title: IT Technician
positions.description: Performed computer maintenance at the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) in Tanzania.

positions.title: Public Relations Officer
positions.description:
Maintained the Interact IST website to promote community awareness. 
Facilitated lessons for underprivileged children at the Wamato School and helped organize International Nite 2003.
